clue.text: A Tory nobleman gives explanation

parts.note: C stands for Conservative, the party whose members are called Tories
a count is a European nobleman

explanation.surface: A Conservative peer offers his reasons.
explanation.definitionFit: To give a full report of events is to explain them; the noun is a common synonym.

clue.text: Exhausted with pleasure seeking soon enough

parts.note: all in is informal for worn out
someone seeking pleasure is out for a good time

explanation.surface: Someone worn out from chasing fun.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means eventually, at the proper moment, without rushing.

clue.text: Elastic developed in Spain

definitions.note: the definition describes a place found in Spain, a historic region and kingdom

indicators.note: the letters of the word elastic are developed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Stretchy material was manufactured in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Castile is a central region and former kingdom of Spain, so it is a place in that country.

clue.text: On the fourth of July detachment shows solidarity

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed on another sits after it in the answer

parts.note: a detachment of soldiers is a military unit

indicators.note: the fourth of points to the letter in fourth position in the word July

explanation.surface: On Independence Day a group shows it stands together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The fourth of July' reads as the US holiday, but it means the fourth letter of July, Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Solidarity is togetherness of purpose, the same as oneness.

clue.text: Keep close to Georgia during attempt at violence

indicators.note: during places the hug-and-Georgia pieces inside the word for attempt

parts.note: a try is an attempt
to hug is to keep someone close
GE is the country code for Georgia

explanation.surface: Holding someone tight in Georgia turns into a violent attempt.
explanation.definitionFit: Thuggery is brutal, violent behaviour of the kind associated with thugs.

clue.text: Superman retains interest in painter

indicators.note: retains means the first word holds another inside it

parts.note: a titan is a person of superhuman strength or stature
i is the usual abbreviation for interest in finance

explanation.surface: The comic-book hero keeps an eye on an artist.
explanation.definitionFit: Titian was the great Venetian Renaissance painter.

clue.text: Quake when losing millions in bet

indicators.note: when losing says a letter is dropped from the shaking word

parts.note: to quake is to tremble
m is the abbreviation for million

explanation.surface: Someone shudders after losing millions on a wager.
explanation.definitionFit: In horse-racing a treble is a single wager on three selections, all of which must win.

clue.text: In the plateau bad weather can be focused

indicators.note: In at the head of the clue puts the bad weather inside the plateau

parts.note: a table, or tableland, is a plateau
rain is bad weather

explanation.surface: Up on the high plateau the bad weather can be concentrated.
explanation.definitionFit: Something trainable can be aimed or directed, as a gun or camera is trained on a target.

clue.text: Transport company has a means for blowing up tyres

definitions.meaning: a firm that carries passengers by plane

definitions.text: a means for blowing up tyres
definitions.meaning: a hose at a garage forecourt that pumps air into tyres

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a passenger carrier in the sky and a hose supplying compressed air.

clue.text: Weariness makes lads use it wrongly

indicators.note: wrongly says the letters of lads use it are put in the wrong order

explanation.surface: Fatigue causes boys to misuse something.
explanation.definitionFit: Lassitude is physical or mental tiredness and lack of energy.

clue.text: Bishop leaves burial site in flight

indicators.note: leaves says the bishop departs from the burial site

parts.note: a barrow is an ancient burial mound
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A churchman walks out of a graveyard in a hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in flight' suggests fleeing; 'flight' is an old word for a light arrow, and 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight is a light, long-distance arrow used in archery.

clue.text: Cyclist's leader excited entrepreneur

parts.note: a wheeler is one who rides on wheels, a cyclist

indicators.note: excited says the letters of leader are stirred up

explanation.surface: The head of a cycling team gets worked up about business.
explanation.definitionFit: A wheeler-dealer is a shrewd operator in business, a wily entrepreneur.

clue.text: Curious about one being boisterous

indicators.note: about means the first word goes around the other

parts.note: nosy means inquisitive
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone inquisitive about a single person is being rowdy.
explanation.definitionFit: Boisterous behaviour is loud and rowdy.

clue.text: Meat dish is an element in wind

indicators.note: in places the two pieces inside the word for wind

parts.note: a gale is a strong wind
tin is a chemical element

explanation.surface: A meal is said to be one of the elements of wind.
explanation.definitionFit: A galantine is a dish of boned, stuffed white meat served cold in aspic.

clue.text: Unconcealed anger creates fatigue

parts.note: overt means open, not hidden
ire is anger

explanation.surface: Open rage leaves one exhausted.
explanation.definitionFit: To fatigue someone is to wear them out, to make them too weary.

clue.text: Dissenter staggered, showing exhaustion

indicators.note: staggered says the letters of dissenter are knocked out of order

explanation.surface: A rebel reeled about, worn out.
explanation.definitionFit: Exhaustion is extreme weariness.

clue.text: Sicken when contracting beastly disease and in limited decline

indicators.note: contracting here means taking in, so the disease goes inside the word for sicken

parts.note: to ail is to be ill
BSE is bovine spongiform encephalopathy, mad cow disease

explanation.surface: Falling ill after catching mad cow disease and going into a gradual decline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contracting' reads as catching an illness, but here it means taking in; 'and in' are linking words.
explanation.definitionFit: To abseil is to make a controlled descent down a rope, a decline kept within limits.

clue.text: Brilliant report on bible editor

parts.note: a tale is an account or report
NT is the New Testament, part of the Bible

explanation.surface: A news report about the scriptures' editor.
explanation.definitionFit: Talented means gifted, with brilliant natural ability.

clue.text: Lust of French father

parts.note: de is French for of
to sire is to father; a sire is a father

explanation.surface: The longing of a French dad.
explanation.definitionFit: Lust is strong craving, especially sexual longing.

clue.text: Assume son finished model

parts.note: up means over, as in time's up
to pose is to model for an artist

explanation.surface: A boy's modelling career is over, one supposes.
explanation.definitionFit: To assume is to take something for granted without proof.

clue.text: Old publican and sailor entertaining French writer

indicators.note: entertaining means hosting, holding the writer inside

parts.note: a tar is a sailor
Jules Verne was the French author of Around the World in Eighty Days

explanation.surface: An innkeeper of old and a seaman play host to a French novelist.
explanation.definitionFit: A taverner was an innkeeper who ran a tavern, an archaic word.

clue.text: Well-versed in Latin translation of wedding

definitions.note: an adjectival phrase, matching the adjective

indicators.note: in places the well-versed word inside the reworked letters
translation means the word Latin is rendered in a new form

parts.note: to be up on a subject is to be well-informed

explanation.surface: Someone fluent in Latin translates a wedding text.
explanation.definitionFit: Nuptial is the adjective describing a marriage ceremony.

clue.text: Marksman gets bird on the right

parts.note: a snipe is a wading bird

explanation.surface: A shooter bags a wader on the right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the right' places R after SNIPE; 'gets' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A sniper is a skilled marksman shooting from cover.

clue.text: Thoughtlessness right away leads to rudeness

indicators.note: away tells us right is removed from the thoughtless word

parts.note: imprudence is lack of care or forethought

explanation.surface: Carelessness, once its virtue is gone, turns into bad manners.
explanation.definitionFit: Impudence is cheeky disrespect, insolent rudeness.

clue.text: They say circuits deteriorate

indicators.note: they say signals a word that sounds like what is heard

parts.note: laps are circuits of a track

explanation.surface: People claim the racing circuits are getting worse.
explanation.definitionFit: To lapse is to slip back or decline into a worse state.

clue.text: Weapon is somewhat unbalanced

indicators.note: is somewhat says only part of the following word is used

explanation.surface: A weapon is a little off balance.
explanation.definitionFit: A lance is a long spear carried by a mounted knight.

clue.text: European turns to Spain for escape

indicators.note: turns says the word for the European is read backwards

parts.note: a Pole is a European
E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: A traveller heads for Spain to get away.
explanation.definitionFit: To elope is to run off secretly, usually to marry.

clue.text: Modification to pit lane shows promise

indicators.note: modification means the letters of to pit lane are changed around

explanation.surface: Changes to the motor-racing pit lane look promising.
explanation.definitionFit: Potential is latent ability, the promise of future success.

clue.text: Landlord's short of gold

parts.note: less means without, minus
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: The landlord is running out of money.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'Landlord's' stands for 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A lessor is the owner who grants a lease, a landlord.

clue.text: Denizen's intimately embraced by communist, on reflection

indicators.note: embraced by puts the intimate word inside the other piece
on reflection says the word for communist is mirrored, read backwards

parts.note: a red is a communist
to know someone well is to know them intimately

explanation.surface: A resident is held close by a left-winger, looking back.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'Denizen's' stands for 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A denizen is an inhabitant or resident of a place.
